Team / Emily,

Quick kickoff for the Pre-QBR leadership packet — this thread will capture a concise snapshot I can fold into the exec deck. Key asks:

- One-paragraph current status for your area (what's green/yellow/red).
- Top 2 launch timeline risks and the mitigation we can commit to before the QBR.
- Any OKR slippage to surface and whether we need to rebaseline expectations.

Laura: please attach the latest release cadence plan and a quick heatmap of OKR health if you have it. Monica/Karthik/Aditya: focus on engineering constraints (infra, model onboarding, end-to-end validation).

I will consolidate by Wednesday morning PST and pull into the QBR pre-read. Emily / Rajiv — flagged you so we can call out NovaApps’ integration window (their ETA is still the critical path for the public beta). If the ETA changes, flag it here.

Deliverable timeline: updates here by EOD Tuesday (1/19) preferred.

Thanks,
Vivek

On Mon, Jan 18, 2027 at 09:22 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team / Emily,
> 
> Quick kickoff for the Pre-QBR leadership packet — this thread will capture a concise snapshot I can fold into the exec deck. Key asks:
> 
> - One-paragraph current status for your area (what's green/yellow/red).
> - Top 2 launch timeline risks and the mitigation we can commit to before the QBR.
> - Any OKR slippage to surface and whether we need to rebaseline expectations.

Thanks Vivek — attaching the cadence and the OKR heatmap (see attachments). Short summary below: 

Status (Product): 
- Overall: Yellow. Two main slippages: (1) feature parity for the hosted API admin controls (auth + rate limits) is ~2 sprints behind; (2) the model-variant fallback policy needs integration testing with Dedicated infra before launch.

Top risks & mitigations:
1) Hosted auth controls delay — mitigation: ship minimal auth UI with API-only controls this sprint and schedule follow-up UX patch in the next release. Owner: Aditya Rao.
2) Fallback policy integration tests failing on Dedicated — mitigation: run weekend soak test on dedicated staging cluster (requested burst GPU windows). Owner: Karthik Iyer.

OKR notes: OKR-3 (Reduce per-token unit cost by 12%) is tracking at -6% to target due to lower-than-expected cache hit rates. Proposal: re-scope noncritical caching experiments from Q1 into Q2 to stabilize launch commitments.

Attachments: Release_Cadence_Plan.pdf; OKR_Health_Heatmap.xlsx

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pre-QBR leadership prep: roadmap status, launch timing, and delivery risk heatcheck

Vivek / Laura — quick infra engineering update: 

Status (Engineering & Reliability): 
- Overall: Yellow/Red on the Dedicated soak window. We found two memory fragmentation scenarios on the 80-token baseline that cause reproducible OOMs after ~72 hours. Root cause appears tied to a recently merged KV cache optimization.

Top risks & mitigations:
1) OOMs in Dedicated soak (blocks canary) — mitigation: revert the KV cache refactor on staging for the soak, and run a debug build that retains current stable eviction semantics. ETA for revert + soak: 48 hours if GPU burst is granted. Owner: Karthik Iyer.
2) Capacity scheduling for public beta (burst allocation) — mitigation: coordinate with sales/ops to reserve burst window w/ cloud partner (Emily / Rajiv on this thread). If we can secure a 24–36 hour burst in week of 1/25, we can validate the fallback and rollout policy. Owner: Monica Patel (ops coordination).

Notes: I attached a short launch contingency draft (Launch_Contingency_Playbook.docx) with suggested gating rules.

Monica

--
Monica Patel
Head of Reliability & Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@novaapps.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv@novaapps.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pre-QBR leadership prep: roadmap status, launch timing, and delivery risk heatcheck

Thanks for the quick updates — consolidated notes and next steps below (I'll pull these into the QBR pre-read slide deck):

Executive snapshot:
- Overall readiness: Yellow. We have technical mitigations defined but need two operational commitments to proceed to canary next week: (A) Dedicated GPU burst window (24–36 hours) provisioned for week of 1/25; (B) temporary revert of the KV cache refactor on staging to complete soak and confirm OOM fix.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Monica: Secure burst GPU window with cloud partner — due 1/21 EOD. (If external partner cannot commit, escalate to sales & partnerships.)
- Karthik: Revert KV cache change on staging and kick off 72-hour soak — start by 1/21 morning; report by 1/23.
- Aditya: Ship minimal auth UI/API toggle and document the follow-up UX patch timeline — due 1/24.
- Laura: Update OKR heatmap with worst-case impact scenarios for QBR slide (include +/- ranges) — due 1/22.

Contingency: If soak fails or burst window is not available, we will delay public beta by one release and execute the contingency gating plan (see attached Launch_Contingency_Playbook.docx).

Emily / Rajiv: please confirm NovaApps’ ability to provide a fixed integration window the week of 1/25 — even a tentative hold will help us keep the canary target.

I'll prepare the one-slide summary for execs and include the attachments + JIRA-ENG-1984 as the technical ticket reference. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.

Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
